FINAL: The best fare confirmed with a booking offer is $861 USD round trip per adult in economy, New York JFK–London Heathrow, June 25–July 5, 2027: Aer Lingus outbound and SWISS returning, with one stop each way. Google Flights offers it through Booking.com as “Separate tickets booked together.”

Outbound: June 25, JFK 6:25 PM → June 26, LHR 9:05 AM, via Shannon (SNN). Flights EI 110/EI 380; 9 hr 40 min total, including a 1 hr 30 min connection.
Return: July 5, LHR 6:00 AM → JFK 12:50 PM the same day, via Zurich (ZRH). Flights LX 345/LX 16; 11 hr 50 min total, including a 1 hr 20 min connection. All times are local.

The $861 total includes required taxes and fees for one adult; optional fees may apply. The booking summary shows “Book with Booking.com,” “$861,” and “Separate tickets booked together.”

The lower $836 listing in final.png uses that same Aer Lingus outbound via Shannon (EI 110/EI 380), paired with Lufthansa City Airlines VL 921 and Lufthansa LH 400 returning July 5 via Frankfurt, 6:30 AM–1:20 PM.
